replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heey Ebirdy,

After reviewing the evidence, we came to the verdict that the player is not hacking.
The player is walking away from you as you hit him, therefor doesn't gets as much knockback.
Also you get hit after the player already died. (His death message pops up before you decide to go in the fight again).
If you have more evidence, please create another report since I'll deny this one.

Regards Flo/resepignev
